mounts.provenance_note: REPAIR ROUND (2026-09-29): resized to the SAM-only load. Runtime fact verified by the coordinator: select_ready_vls_mount fires the first vls_sam mount with rounds and never reads target_domain, so every counted cell is mechanically a SAM at runtime -- the prior 32-cell mount overstated the SAM inventory by also counting the 8 Yu-8 ASW-rocket cells sharing the same H/AKJ-16 VLS. This mount now holds exactly the ship's sourced HHQ-16 load (24, matching weapon_inventory's representative_load); the remaining 8 of the 32-cell H/AKJ-16 VLS are content-only (Yu-8/CY-5). engagement_range_m/projectile_speed_mps now carry HHQ-16's OWN sourced figures rather than a blended value: 74,080m from HHQ-16's DIA-2019 20-40nmi A-tier band (upper bound 40nmi used, unchanged numeric value from before); projectile_speed_mps changed from the prior blended 1020 m/s to HHQ-16's own engineering-estimate 850 m/s (weapons/csg/cn/hhq_16.json flight_model.max_speed, below HHQ-9B per that record's own reasoning)

1 x 76mm (H/PJ-26) gun per csg-cn-054a-usni-proc-202006 (B, calibre; designation is C-only). Mapped to gun_5in per the task's mount rules (main guns -> gun_5in) despite the smaller 76mm calibre, since gun_5in is the only functional naval-gun NavalWeaponType in the engine; damage_per_hit scaled down from the 130mm gun_5in mounts on 055/052D to reflect the smaller calibre's lower per-shell lethality, an engineering-estimate scaling since no direct proxy exists for a dedicated 76mm mount type

2 x 30mm (Type 730/H/PJ-12 early batches; H/PJ-11/Type 1130 later batches) per csg-cn-054a-usni-proc-202006 (B, 'late units have an improved 30-mm CIWS'). This record instantiates 1 of the 2 mounts as a functional ciws mount per the DDG-51 template's per-mount-representative convention; the 2nd is documented in _real_world only. Tongliao (554, resumed-batch hull) assumed to carry the later H/PJ-11/Type 1130 fit (inference, consistent with the VDS/towed-array late-unit assumption)

REPAIR ROUND (2026-09-29): the YJ-83 gap is now closed -- weapons/csg/cn/yj_83.json written and referenced from weapon_inventory as content_only_no_mechanism (8x/hull, 100-135nmi, B-tier); the free-text _real_world.ascm_note has been removed. The forward_vls_sam mount (renamed hhq16_vls_sam) has been resized from 32 to 24 cells (HHQ-16-only) and now carries HHQ-16's own sourced range/speed rather than a blended value, per the coordinator's runtime-semantics correction: select_ready_vls_mount fires the first vls_sam mount with rounds and never reads target_domain, so the prior mixed HHQ-16+Yu-8 32-cell mount mechanically overstated the SAM inventory by counting Yu-8 cells as SAM rounds.

gun_5in mapping for the 76mm H/PJ-26 gun is an engineering-estimate scaling of damage_per_hit down from the 130mm gun_5in mounts on 055/052D, since the task's mount rules specify 'main guns (130mm, 100mm) as gun_5in' without explicitly listing 76mm; 76mm is included as the ship's only main gun and gun_5in is the only functional naval-gun mount type available.

2 x 6-tube 240mm ASW rocket launchers (deck-mounted, separate from VLS) have no NavalWeaponType mount and are documented only as damage_model.hitboxes components, consistent with how the Fujian record treats its anti-torpedo/anti-swimmer launchers.
